messages:
mira: Heads-up: Lumina (customer) requested Ormond-3B (3.1B) onboarding to Private. Requirements: int8 quant support, throughput target ~600 tok/s, <20ms p99 on their Dedicated A100 cluster, and no >5% quality regression vs their baseline eval. Dropping artifacts and initial notes here for triage.

devin: Thanks — can you attach the model format? HF checkpoint, GGML, or ONNX? Also need the eval suite + a few sample prompts.

mira: They sent a tar with `ormond-3b/` HF weights (pytorch), config.json, and a small eval set (1k examples) — uploaded to /mnt/lumina/ormond3b/ on staging. Eval set: customer_chat_small.json.

rahul: Quick ask: any domain-specific tokens/vocab or special BOS/EOS handling? If tokenization differs we need tokenizer mapping.

mira: Tokenizer is standard bpe (vocab size 50288). No special tokens.

jenna: Did a smoke run on a single A100 (40GB) in fp16: 512-token generation, `batch=4` -> p99 ~22ms, median ~8ms, throughput ~580 tok/s. Quality (BLEU-ish proxy) matches baseline within 1.2%.

jenna: Tried the standard q8_0 quant pipeline (internal script `tools/quantize.py --profile q8_0`) and saw severe decode drift. Perplexity +9, and hallucinations increase on the eval set. Logs:```QuantPass: layer 143: scale overflow at 0.23
QuantizeSummary: 17% layers hit fallback
OutputSampleBefore: "The patient said he felt"\nOutputSampleAfter: "The patient been apple"```

ops-bot: CI job #5123: quant-smoke -> FAILED (exit 2). Artifacts: /ci/artifacts/5123/quant-smoke.log

devin: Ok. Two paths: 1) iterate quant profiles (q4_0 / q5_0 / q4_1), 2) enable per-channel calibration or layerwise FP16 passthrough for attention/ffn. Jenna — can you try q4_1 and q5_0 quickly?

jenna: On it. q4_1 run started. Quick note: KV cache footprint is ~3.2GB for 2048 seq in fp16 — int configs should reduce mem but check alignment with Private runtime.

rahul: Also need to run regression eval (the 1k set) with sampling seeds fixed and compare a QA metric + response length distribution. If qX profiles change length bias we need to track.

mira: Customer cares about instruction-following fidelity. I'll ask them to prioritize the 1k eval examples they really care about (they flagged 200 out of 1k as 'high priority').

jenna: q4_1 results: p99 18ms (nice), throughput ~640 tok/s, but quality delta is +2.8% (worse) on the proxy metric. Some prompt completions truncate earlier. Ran with `--kv-pass-through false --layerwise-fp16-attn true`

devin: That p99 is within their target. But quality delta might be acceptable if under 5% — still needs signoff. Mira, can we propose a canary rollout: host q4_1 variant on Dedicated with A/B traffic 10% for 48h and compare customer eval + live telemetry (latency, fallback rate, perplexity proxy)?

mira: Yes. Customer ok with canary if we provide rollback plan.

rahul: Rollback plan: automatic fallback to fp16 if perplexity delta crosses +5% on the live eval set OR if error rate >0.5% for generation RPCs. Canary monitors: p99 latency, mean tokens/s, eval metric, and top-1 logit anomalies.

jenna: I'll prepare the quant-profile diffs and a small runbook. Quick checklist I suggest for full onboarding:
- confirm tokenizer + vocab parity
- run deterministic eval (1k) for fp16 baseline
- run q4_1/q5_0 with calibration, collect metrics (p99, tok/s, eval delta)
- KV cache mem profile at common seq lengths (512/1024/2048)
- canary config (10% traffic, 48h, rollback triggers)
- security scan (no external code, weights checksum)
- packaging: container + model manifest for Private control plane

mira: Assigning: jenna -> quant runs + runbook; devin -> canary infra + monitoring hooks; rahul -> regression eval scripts + rollback rules. I'll own customer comms and final signoff. :thumbsup:

devin: Noted. I'll also reserve Dedicated slots for 48h canary. ETA: infra ready by EOD tomorrow.

jenna: Put progress notes in the onboarding doc: /docs/onboard/ormond3b/ — starting with quant comparisons. Will paste short results here when done. :eyes:

mira: Thanks everyone. If q4_1 stays within <5% delta we can proceed to canary. If not, we'll try layerwise FP16 passthrough and re-evaluate.

devin: ops-bot will post CI status updates.

ops-bot: CI job #5125: q4_1-smoke -> SUCCESS (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/5125/q4_1-smoke.log)

jenna: Dropping initial CSV of metrics: `fp16_p99,fp16_tok_s,q4_1_p99,q4_1_tok_s,eval_delta` -> `22,580,18,640,2.8` — uploading full traces to the onboarding doc.

mira: OK closing intake for triage — moving to 'canary prep' column on the board. Any blockers, ping here.
